svg.title: PJM capacity prices went from record lows to the price cap in three auctions

cc:Work.dc:title: PJM capacity prices went from record lows to the price cap in three auctions
cc:Work.dc:description: Step chart of PJM capacity prices: under $55/MW-day for three years, $270 in 2025/26 (Dominion zone $444), then at the cap of about $330.
